top_categories.workout_context: 76ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Dusty Bandita, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Dusty Bandita's Montana mountains, Local event forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 85 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Dusty Bandita. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Dusty Bandita's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
6,500ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,500ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 85 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Dusty Bandita, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Low-cadence force work for 6,500ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Dusty Bandita’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Dusty Bandita. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Dusty Bandita requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on montana mountain gravel to build confidence. Expect: montana mountains, local event, mountain west gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 85 miles of montana mountain gravel in Ovando, Montana.
